# The Tyler Simmons Team - South Carolina Real Estate Experts

> The Tyler Simmons Team helps people buy, sell, relocate, and invest in real estate across South Carolina, with statewide service from Columbia and the Midlands to Florence, Myrtle Beach, York County, and coastal markets.

## What The Team Helps With

- Buying a home anywhere in South Carolina
- Selling a home with pricing, staging, marketing, and negotiation support
- Relocation guidance for people moving to or within South Carolina
- Investment property research and buyer representation
- Home value consultations and local market insight

[Visit the website](https://isellscre.com/): Meet the team, review services, search homes, and contact an agent.

## Main Site Pages

- [Home](https://isellscre.com/): Overview of the team, services, service areas, testimonials, home search, FAQ, and contact form.
- [Home Estimate](https://isellscre.com/eval.html): Start a home value conversation.
- [Lending Partner](https://isellscre.com/lend.html): Mortgage and lending information.
- [Careers / Team Info](https://isellscre.com/care.html): Information related to team opportunities and support.
- [Text Us](https://isellscre.com/text.html): Contact and text-message oriented page.
- [Privacy Policy](https://isellscre.com/privacy.html): Privacy information.

## Service Areas

The team serves South Carolina statewide, including Columbia, Lexington, Irmo, Chapin, Blythewood, Florence, Myrtle Beach, Rock Hill, Chester, York County, Richland County, Lexington County, Fairfield County, Florence County, Horry County, and the Lake Murray region.
